headline: World Cup Final: Argentina and Spain locked at 0-0 at half-time
summary: Defending champions Argentina and Spain remain scoreless in a tense opening half at MetLife Stadium.
details: Defending champions Argentina and Spain are locked in a 0-0 stalemate at half-time in the 2026 FIFA World Cup final.
The match is taking place at the MetLife Stadium, where the European champions, Spain, have held more of the possession throughout the first half.
Spain created several chances, with teenager Lamine Yamal attempting an early effort and Mikel Oyarzabal shooting directly at goalkeeper Emiliano Martinez.
Marc Cucurella also came close to scoring for Spain, flashing a shot across the goal shortly before the half-time whistle.
Lionel Messi's Argentina are fighting for a fourth World Cup title, while Spain are seeking their second trophy in history.

headline_marked: 10,000 Iranians left without water after [[US strike hits desalination plant]]
headline: 10,000 Iranians left without water after US strike hits desalination plant
summary: A US attack on a water facility in Hormozgan province has disrupted drinking water for 20 villages, amid rising Middle East tensions.
details: A US strike on a water desalination plant in the coastal village of Bunji, Hormozgan province, has left approximately 10,000 people without drinking water. The attack completely disrupted the supply to 20 villages, creating a severe water shortage crisis, according to the CEO of the Hormozgan Water and Wastewater Company.

The incident occurs as tensions escalate in the Middle East, with the US and Iran continuing to exchange attacks. In response to the volatility, the US government has warned its citizens against traveling to Lebanon and northern parts of Israel.

The US Embassy in Beirut cited a complex security environment with the potential for unforeseen escalation. Similarly, the US Embassy in Jerusalem advised Americans to avoid Gaza, Northern Israel, and the Egyptian border.
According to Iran's health ministry, US strikes since June 27 have killed 50 people and injured over 500 others. This toll includes five women and children or teenagers under 18.

Iran's Deputy Foreign Minister, Kazem Gharibabadi, stated that the US has violated the Islamabad MoU signed last month. Consequently, Tehran has suspended its own commitments under the agreement to focus on national defense.
caption:
10,000 people in Iran are facing a water crisis after a US strike destroyed a desalination plant.

A US strike on a water desalination plant in the coastal village of Bunji, Hormozgan province, has left approximately 10,000 people without drinking water. The attack completely disrupted the supply to 20 villages, creating a severe water shortage crisis, according to the CEO of the Hormozgan Water and Wastewater Company.

The incident occurs as tensions escalate in the Middle East, with the US and Iran continuing to exchange attacks. In response to the volatility, the US government has warned its citizens against traveling to Lebanon and northern parts of Israel.

The US Embassy in Beirut cited a complex security environment with the potential for unforeseen escalation. Similarly, the US Embassy in Jerusalem advised Americans to avoid Gaza, Northern Israel, and the Egyptian border.

According to Iran's health ministry, US strikes since June 27 have killed 50 people and injured over 500 others. This toll includes five women and children or teenagers under 18.

Iran's Deputy Foreign Minister, Kazem Gharibabadi, stated that the US has violated the Islamabad MoU signed last month. Consequently, Tehran has suspended its own commitments under the agreement to focus on national defense.
